facts.fact: Kanifing Municipal Council's Rates Manager says the council has integrated Google Plus Codes into its property rates database, and collectors carry tablets to navigate to registered properties (article of 29 June 2026; no date given for the integration).

The property rates database and the compliance mapping system are described as the Kanifing Municipal Council's own, with no national system or reporting to the centre mentioned (article of 29 June 2026).
Only the Kanifing Municipal Council is described as using the system; the article gives no total of local governments (article of 29 June 2026).

systems.platform: database with Google Plus Codes and tablets for collectors

systems.owner: Kanifing Municipal Council with the Ministry of Information
